title: CEK plaintext not zeroized in decrypt() caller path
description: find_and_decrypt_cek() returns Zeroizing<Vec<u8>>, but decrypt() passes the Zeroizing wrapper to decrypt_aes128_cbc/decrypt_aes256_cbc as &[u8] via auto-deref. The Zeroizing drops only after the entire decrypt() function returns, so the CEK bytes survive on the stack or heap until that point — which is fine. BUT: the plaintext output Vec<u8> returned from decrypt() is not zeroized. If the caller's use case warrants zeroizing the CEK it likely also warrants zeroizing the plaintext. This is a public API ergonomics / security policy gap: the API makes it easy to forget to zeroize the output.
close_reason: Caller responsibility. Changing return type to Zeroizing<Vec<u8>> would be a breaking API change and is a caller design decision. Opinion.
